build_fpn_ResNet50_body: build a detectron model by adding an FPN onto a ResNet50 conv5 backbone
build_fpn_ResNet101_body: build a detectron model by adding an FPN onto a ResNet101 conv5 backbone
build_fpn_onto_conv_body: build FPN levels onto any conv body backbone using add_fpn_onto_conv_body
add_fpn_rpn_outputs: add RPN outputs with shared weights across multiple FPN pyramid levels
map_rois_to_fpn_levels: map a set of RoIs to their target FPN levels using the FPN paper heuristic
